t: Flomasta brass compression equal 90° elbows provide a robust solution for plumbing installations. These 15mm pipe fittings are designed for creating secure and leak-free directional changes in pipework, essential for both domestic and commercial projects. Ideal for connecting copper or plastic pipes in tight spaces, such as under sinks or behind appliances, these elbows ensure a reliable 90° turn. The durable brass construction offers excellent corrosion resistance and longevity, making them a dependable choice for professional plumbers and heating engineers seeking quality compression fittings.
b: Suitable for Hard & Soft Water Areas
